spans.s:
1 छद् only pp. छन्न (q.v.) & C. छाद॑यति (˚ते)
cover, veil, hide, conceal, keep secret. —अभि C. cover. अव C.
cover, overspread, hide, veil, obscure, conceal. आ C. cover, clothe
(M. also refl.), hide, obscure. परि C. wrap round, envelop, cover.
प्र C. cover (M. refl.), hide, veil in (instr.), conceal, keep secret.
प्रति C. overspread, clothe, envelop. सम् the same. — Cf.
अवच्छन्न, आच्छन्न, उपच्छन्न, परिच्छन्न, प्रच्छन्न,
प्रतिच्छन्न, संछन्न.

2 छद् & छन्द् छन्त्ति छन्दति छद॑यति
(छद॑य˚ते) seem, appear, pass for (nom.), please;
 M. like, be
pleased with (acc. or loc.).
[]
C. छन्दयति offer (w. acc. of
pers. & instr. of th.);
 allure, strive to corrupt. —उप C. = S. C.
सम् offer ( = S. C.).

छद a. covering (—˚);
 m. cover, veil, wing, leaf.

छद्^1इ a. covering (—˚).
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: Verb. Text missing virAma.

छद्मरूपिन् a. having the feigned form of, disguised
as (—˚).
छद्मिन् a. having the feigned form of, disguised as (—˚).
